The used or expired activation link says This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one., not the missing-token message the script first waited for.
The two-factor disable dialog confirms with Continue.

Record titles sit outside main; section tabs were selected by href; the Task completion control is a checkbox named Complete Task: <title>; See all results is a listbox option; Filter opens a dialog of property buttons; the views trigger is named after the current view; the To date label collided with Back to filters; the timezone input was targeted by id.
A regex matched the query echoed in No matches for ..., which briefly looked like a confidentiality leak; the check now requires a result link.
Portal Help search is scoped to the current topic; the sign-in guide is bound to the entry page, so the index or an unscoped search reaches it.
One C03 rerun raced a concurrent C01 rerun on a freshly invited account and was repeated alone.
